name: Progress-27
about: Progress-27 (1987-005A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1987 Jan 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1987 Jan 25), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
